description: This file defines the ReportRepository class, which provides database access methods for 'report' entities, including findById, findAll, insert, deleteById, findByProjectId, and findTemplates. It interacts with MySQL database using prepared statements and manages report data and related attachments.

classes.name: ReportRepository
classes.description: Repository class for handling database operations related to 'report' entities, including fetching, inserting, and deleting report records.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Retrieves a report by its ID, returning an associative array or null if not found.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Retrieves the most recent 20 reports with associated project and attachment info.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a new report record into the database and returns the insert ID.

methods.name: deleteById
methods.description: Deletes a report record by its ID.

methods.name: findByProjectId
methods.description: Retrieves all reports linked to a specific project ID, including attachments.

methods.name: findTemplates
methods.description: Retrieves all reports marked as templates along with their attachment details.
